json.rationale: This is a crossroads with no sign, light or marking regulating priority. The default rule is to give way (ceda el paso) only to vehicles approaching from your right (prioridad a la derecha). As no road users are visible, there is nobody to give way to, so you may proceed.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: You must yield and wait even though the junction is completely empty.
json.whyWrong: The rule only obliges you to yield (ceda el paso) to vehicles approaching from the right. With no vehicle coming from the right, there is no one to give way to.
